# WoW Forever Talent Calculator

> Independent, fan-made talent planning tool for WoW Forever (World of
> Warcraft). Free to use, no sign-up or login required. Covers all 9 classes
> with 3 talent trees each under the standard 51-point budget (first point at
> level 10, one per level through 60; rows gate every 5 points spent earlier
> in the same tree). Builds can be saved locally, shared as URL-encoded
> links, and compared point by point.

## Reference & policy pages

- [Talent reference index](https://wowforevertalent.app/talents/): per-rank effect text, grid positions, Classic comparison
- [Talent changes vs Classic](https://wowforevertalent.app/changes/): new / changed / moved / unchanged / removed counts per class
- [Legacy system](https://wowforevertalent.app/legacy/): all 20 Legacy perks across Adventure, Resourcefulness, and Professions, plus a 16-point planner
- [Wiki](https://wowforevertalent.app/wiki/): what World of Warcraft: Forever is — official launch dates (global and CN), talent and Legacy systems, camping, professions, rulesets, and the nine classes
- [Data & sources](https://wowforevertalent.app/sources/): snapshot IDs, evidence-status definitions, coverage, CC BY 4.0 attribution
- [About](https://wowforevertalent.app/about/)
- [Privacy](https://wowforevertalent.app/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://wowforevertalent.app/terms/)

## Data notes

- Talent data originates from talentsforever.com under CC BY 4.0 and is
  published as immutable, content-hashed snapshots.
- Every rank effect carries an evidence status (official, community record,
  source estimate, unknown). Ranks without confirmed text are labeled
  "unknown" rather than guessed.
- This is a fan-made site and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard
  Entertainment. Official sites: worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com (EN) and
  wow.blizzard.cn/forever (中文“无限”官网).
